caption: Right after the Shopify install the app sent us to a separate Tapstitch login. It only works with its own Tapstitch account. We filled in nothing here.
In the Tapstitch dashboard the Essential Cotton T-Shirt reached a mockup in about 11 minutes. The WordArt style still showed the placeholder add text here, not our own text.
The price list in the designer: EUR 5.45 for the blank tee plus EUR 2.61 to EUR 3.04 for a front print, EUR 8.06 to EUR 8.49 in total before shipping and taxes.
The size guide gives inches and centimetres, from S (67.5 cm long, 50 cm chest) to 3XL, and warns that sizes can vary by 1 to 3 cm. Fit was not tested.
The wallet shows USD 0.00 credit and asks for a card to cover orders. We found no plan page and added no card, so nothing was ordered or paid.
